texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_INTRO:
Welcome to Star Joker!

To help you get started we've created an easy step tutorial to guide you through the game. No real money will be involved at this point. Hit the CONTINUE to begin!
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_GAMBLE_TEXT3: You have the option to gamble your winnings a further four times or until you have won 250 x your initial win. Alternatively you can collect your winnings at any point by clicking the COLLECT button! Let's collect and move onto the next step.
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_GAMBLE_TEXT2: Correctly guess the colour of the card dealt, and you instantly double your winnings. Guess the correct suit and your winnings are quadrupled.
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_GAMBLE_TEXT1: Each time you have a winning SPIN, you can look to double or even quadruple your winnings! Click on the GAMBLE button and we'll give it a go.
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_GAMBLE_TEXT0: Let's see if your good luck can continue by playing our gamble feature.
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_FREESPIN_TEXT4: We'll skip the remaining free spins to shorten the tutorial for you.
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_FREESPIN_TEXT3: As suggested in the name, all spins in this round come at no cost.
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_END_TEXT_REAL: Click on the OK button to start playing Star Joker using your real money balance. Best of luck!
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_END_TEXT_DEMO: Click on the OK button to start playing Star Joker. Best of luck!
texts.IDS_TUTORIAL_END_TEXT: You have completed the tutorial. You can now tell all your friends how to play slots!

texts.IDS_TOM_FREE_ROUND_INTRO2: Open all Eye Marks to summon the MEGA WILD!
texts.IDS_TOM_FREE_ROUND_INTRO1: “That is not dead which can eternal lie, And with strange aeons even death may die.” – Abdul Alhazred
texts.IDS_TOM_FPS2: Open all eyes during the OTHER WORLD FREE ROUND to summon the MEGA WILD!
texts.IDS_TOM_FPS1: Charge the Portal to trigger unique Portal Effects and the OTHER WORLD FREE ROUND.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_4_4: GEMSTONE and KONGAR COIN substitute for all symbols except SCATTER.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_4_3: WILD symbols only appear on reels 2, 3, and 4.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_4_2: KONGAR COIN reveals a MULTIPLIER during KONGAR COINS and KONGAR’S RICHES features.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_4_1: Appears during the KONGAR COINS and KONGAR’S RICHES features.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_8: Each SCATTER adds 1 FREE SPIN, up to a maximum of 100 FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_7: KONGAR COIN symbols may reveal an X2, X3, X4, or X5 MULTIPLIER when triggered in the KONGAR’S RICHES.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_6: KONGAR COINS cannot overlap with SCATTER, KONGAR COIN, or KONGAR symbols.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_5: KONGAR awards 3 to 5 KONGAR COINS during the KONGAR COINS feature.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_4: KONGAR COINS feature can be randomly triggered during FREE SPINS, awarding 3 to 5 KONGAR COIN symbols.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_3: All KONGAR symbols on the reels are upgraded, increasing payout during the FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_2: More SCATTERS award more initial FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_2_1: 3 to 5 SCATTERS trigger KONGAR’S RICHES, awarding FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_1_7: KONGAR COINS feature can be awarded randomly in a game round when a GEMSTONE is collected.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_1_6: MULTIPLIERS are added together and applied to all wins.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_1_5: KONGAR COIN symbols may reveal an X2 or X3 MULTIPLIER when triggered in the base game.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_1_4: KONGAR COINS cannot overlap with SCATTER, GEMSTONE, or KONGAR symbols.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_1_3: 2 to 3 KONGAR COIN symbols can be awarded.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_1_2: All KONGAR symbols on the reels are upgraded, resulting in increased payouts.
texts.IDS_TOK_SECTION_1_1: KONGAR above the reels collects a GEMSTONE when it lands.
texts.IDS_TOK_PT2_2: When forming a winning combination it triggers a Respin and moves to a random Reel.
texts.IDS_TOK_PT1_3: When it lands partially on a Reel, the Inari Stacked Wild has a chance to Nudge and cover the Reel if it would form a winning combination.
texts.IDS_TOK_PT1_2: The Inari Stacked Wild moves to a random Reel on every Respin.
texts.IDS_TOK_PT1_1: Wins with the Inari Stacked Wild trigger a Respin with an increasing Multiplier – up to x25.
texts.IDS_TOK_INFOLINE2: Stacked Wild wins trigger a free Respin
texts.IDS_TOK_INFOLINE1: Stacked Wild wins increase the Multiplier
texts.IDS_TOK_INFO_1: 3 or more SCATTERS trigger KONGAR'S RICHES.
texts.IDS_TOK_GOLDRUSH_INFO: KONGAR upgrades and increases its payout!
texts.IDS_TOK_FPS1: Win with the Inari Stacked Wild to trigger a Respin with an increasing Multiplier
texts.IDS_TOK_FPS_1: Upgrade KONGAR and be showered with his wealth and fortune!
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_PORTAL_TH4_DESC: 48 charges award the DAMNATION FREE SPIN.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_PORTAL_TH3_EFFECT: ABOMINATION upgrades a gem to a ritual item.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_PORTAL_TH3_DESC: 30 charges award 2-4 BOOK WILDS. Winning with these triggers ABOMINATION.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_PORTAL_TH2_EFFECT: HARVEST aims for symbols spots 2 symbols away in all diagonal directions and all spots 3 symbols away in all horizontal and vertical directions, and destroys symbols in these spots, if possible.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_PORTAL_TH2_DESC: 16 charges award 2-4 BOOK WILDS. Winning with these triggers HARVEST.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_PORTAL_CHARGE: All winning symbols charge the Portal.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_MULTI_WILD_DESC:
May bring 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x multipliers in Base Game.
May bring 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x multipliers in Bonus Game.
When more than one MULTIPLIER WILD is present in a winning cluster only the highest multiplier is applied.
MULTIPLIER WILD and multiplier YOG-SOTHOTH WILD values are multiplied.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_MEGA_WILD_DESC: A 2x2 WILD that walks 3 times on the grid.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_FS_OVERCH: After the 48 charges are reached, a DAMNATION FREE SPIN will be guaranteed with 3 Portal features, but the Portal can be overcharged to get an extra Portal feature for every 4 additional winning symbols, up to a maximum of 7.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_FS_EFFECTS: 1 random Portal feature is triggered when no wins are achieved after a cascade, until all are used up.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_FS_DONE: The DAMNATION FREE SPIN concludes when all Portal Effects have been played out.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_FS_COUNTER: The number of portal charges and the multiplier value is displayed on the Portal Charger.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_EYES_OPEN: In the base game, opening an ALL-SEEING EYE by forming a win on its location awards 2-4 BOOK WILDS. These are added when no more wins are formed.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_EYES_FREESPIN: During DAMNATION FREE SPIN, opening every ALL-SEEING EYE summons the YOG-SOTHOTH WILD, while additionally opening 4, 5, 6 special eyes applies 2x, 3x, 4x multipliers to it.
texts.IDS_TOI_PT_EYES_CREATE:
An ALL-SEEING EYE may be created in the base game,
while DAMNATION FREE SPIN offers 12 normal and 6 special Eyes.
texts.IDS_TOI_INTRO:
"He knows where the Old Ones broke through of old, and where They shall break through again. He knows that the stars are aligning and Insanity's gaze shifts to ebon chaos once again."
-H.P. Lovecraft
texts.IDS_TOI_IL_MEGA_SUMMON: YOG-SOTHOTH can be summoned in DAMNATION!
texts.IDS_TOI_IL_FS_MULTI: RICH and YOG-SOTHOTH multipliers combine up to 40x!
texts.IDS_TOI_IL_FS_FEATURES: 3-7 Portal Effects can be obtained for DAMNATION!
texts.IDS_TOI_IL_FS_CHARGER_WILDS: RUIN add 4 BOOK WILDS in DAMNATION FREE SPIN!
texts.IDS_TOI_FREESPIN_MULTI: Open the 4, 5, 6 ALL-SEEING MULTIPLIER EYES to upgrade the YOG-SOTHOTH WILD with 2x, 3x, 4x multipliers!
texts.IDS_TOI_FREESPIN_EYES: Open all 12 ALL-SEEING EYES to summon the YOG-SOTHOTH WILD!
texts.IDS_TOI_FPS_DESC: Charge the portal by winning to activate dark runes and unleash YOG-SOTHOTH onto the grid!
texts.IDS_TOG3_INFOLINE5: TRIGGER UP TO 3 POTS AT THE SAME TIME!
texts.IDS_TOG3_INFOLINE4: Collect purple Gem Scatters to trigger Lock’n Gold Bonus of Anubis!
texts.IDS_TOG3_INFOLINE3: Collect red Gem Scatters to trigger Lock’n Gold Serpent’s Surge!
texts.IDS_TOG3_INFOLINE2: Collect blue Gem Scatters to trigger Lock’n Gold Double Horus!
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS7: Increases Coins value during Lock’n Gold.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS26: Wild symbols can only land in the base game. They can land as regular Wilds or as Multiplier Wilds - x2, x3.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS25: Substitute for all symbols except Gem Scatters.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS23: 4 initial Re-Spins are awarded. Coins can land and stick on each spin. Re-Spins amount is reset when 1+ Coin/Gem Scatters land.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS22: Up to 3 Gem features can be triggered in the Lock’n Gold by landing Gem Scatters.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS21: When Lock’n Gold is triggered, it will be enhanced with one or more of the Gem features.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS19: Up to 3 Gem features can be triggered in the Lock’n Gold by landing Gem Scatters.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS18: When Lock’n Gold is triggered, it will be enhanced with one or more of the Gem features.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS16: Bonus of Anubis: Awards instant bonuses when purple Bonus Scatters are collected in each bonus panel. Instant bonuses are - Mini Bonus: 20 x total bet, Minor Bonus: 50 x total bet, Major Bonus: 100 x total bet, Grand Bonus: 1000 x total bet.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS15: Serpent’s Surge: Red Ignite Scatters land and select 1 Coin Scatter and increases its value throughout the whole Lock’n Gold.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS14: Double Horus: Blue Double Scatters land and select 1-3 Coin Scatters and doubles their value.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS12: Randomly, when 1 or more Gem Scatters land, Lock’n Gold will activate with 1-3 Gem features.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS11: As Gem Scatters are collected, the pots will increase in size, this is purely visual and does not indicate a likeliness of triggering.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS10: Any of the 3 Gem Scatters that land are collected into the pots.
texts.IDS_TOG3_FPS1: Collect Gem Scatters into 3 pots to trigger Lock’n Gold features
texts.IDS_TOG2_WILDSSUB: WILD substitutes all other symbols except COIN SCATTER and SPHINX SCATTER.
texts.IDS_TOG2_WHEEL: PRESS SPIN TO START THE WHEEL!
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT9: Starting MULTIPLIER = x1, x2, x3, x4, x5.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT8:
3 SPHINX SCATTERS = 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 FREE SPINS.
4 SPHINX SCATTERS = 15, 20, 25 and 30 FREE SPINS.
5 SPHINX SCATTERS = 20, 25 and 30 FREE SPINS.
6 SPHINX SCATTERS = 25 and 30 FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT7: Depending on how many SPHINX SCATTERS initially landed to award FREE SPINS, the FREE SPINS segments on the wheel will change.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT6: 3+ SPHINX SCATTERS will trigger the FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT5: Full screen of COIN SCATTERS awards a total of x500 times the total bet regardless of the value of the COIN SCATTERS landed.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT4: Bonus Prizes are: MINI: 20x, MINOR: 50x, MAJOR: 100x and GRAND: 1000x total bet.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT3: If 1 or more COIN SCATTERS is collected, the STACK OF GOLD has a chance to trigger.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT2: The size of STACK OF GOLD is purely visual and will not affect the likeliness of the feature triggering.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT14: Each SPHINX SCATTER that lands will increase the FREE SPIN Counter by +1
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT13: This counter will affect all wins in the FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT12:
When these WILDS land they will add +1, +2 or +3 MULTIPLIER to 
the MULTIPLIER Counter.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT10: Special WILDS can land on any reel.
texts.IDS_TOG2_PT1: If 5 or less COIN SCATTERS land on the reels, they will be collected into the STACK OF GOLD.
texts.IDS_TOG2_NOSCATTER: COIN SCATTERS do not land in FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOG2_INFO2: LAND MULTIPLIER WILDS IN FREE SPINS!
texts.IDS_TOG2_INFO1: WIN BIG WITH THE STACK OF GOLD!
texts.IDS_TOG2_FREESPINPOPUP: UP TO +3 MULTIPLIER PER WILD LANDED
texts.IDS_TOG2_FPS2: GATHER COIN SCATTERS IN THE STACK OF GOLD TO WIN A PRIZE
texts.IDS_TOG_P9_2: The Wheel will have the following values: FREE SPINS: 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. MULTIPLIER: x1, x2, x3, x4, x5
texts.IDS_TOG_P9: Before FREE SPINS commence, a wheel will pop up that will determine the amount of FREE SPINS and starting MULTIPLIER.
texts.IDS_TOG_P8_1: Landing 4+ SPHINX SCATTERS can award an instant prize and triggers the FREE SPINS. The more SPHINX SCATTERS land, the bigger the prize.
texts.IDS_TOG_P8: Land 3 SPHINX SCATTERS to trigger FREE SPINS
texts.IDS_TOG_P7: Maximum MULTIPLIER on each COIN SCATTER is x30, resulting in up to a x900 win.
texts.IDS_TOG_P6: Landing a special COIN SCATTER can give 1 extra FREE SPIN as well as +1 MULTIPLIER.
texts.IDS_TOG_P5:
Each COIN SCATTER that lands increases the MULTIPLIER +1.
5 initial FREE SPINS are awarded.
texts.IDS_TOG_P4_2: 3 initial RE-SPINS are awarded. COIN SCATTERS can land and stick on each spin. RE-SPINS amount is reset when 1+ COIN SCATTERS land.
texts.IDS_TOG_P4:
When triggered, all other symbols are removed.
The MULTIPLIER on each COIN SCATTER depends on the amount of COIN SCATTERS on the reels.
texts.IDS_TOG_P3_1: If 4 or 5 COIN SCATTERS land, the reels with no COIN SCATTERS on will re-spin.
texts.IDS_TOG_P3: Land 6 COIN SCATTERS to trigger LOCK’N GOLD feature.
texts.IDS_TOG_P10: During FREE SPINS, landing a SPHINX SCATTER will increase the FREE SPINS by +1 and each WILD that lands will increase the MULTIPLIER by +1.
texts.IDS_TOG_P1: LAND 6 COIN SCATTERS TO TRIGGER LOCK'N GOLD!

texts.IDS_TOD_IL_MEGA_SUMMON: AMMIT THE DEVOURER can be summoned in BANISHMENT!
texts.IDS_TOD_IL_MEGA_MULTI: AMMIT THE DEVOURER can bring 2x, 3x, 4x multipliers!
texts.IDS_TOD_IL_FS_MULTI: RICH and AMMIT THE DEVOURER multipliers combine up to 40x!
texts.IDS_TOD_IL_FS_FEATURES: 3-7 Ritual Effects can be obtained for BANISHMENT!
texts.IDS_TOD_IL_FS_CHARGER_WILDS: PROTECTION add 4 WILD ALTARS in BANISHMENT FREE SPIN!

texts.IDS_TOAFW_PT_4C_FREESPIN_END: FREE SPINS will continue if an expanded THOR WILD appears, otherwise FREE SPINS end.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_PT_4B_SECONDCHANCE: Second chance RE-SPIN is awarded when no expanded THOR WILD appears on the spin.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_PT_4A_WILD_MOVE: An expanded THOR WILD moves one step to the left after each spin, increasing its MULTIPLIER up to x10.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_PT_3A_GUARANTEED_WILD: Expanded THOR WILD is guaranteed to appear on 5th reel at the start of FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_PT_2A_WILD_X2: On any spin, an expanded FREYA WILD with x2 MULTIPLIER can appear on a random reel to create a win.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_MAX_FS2: FREE SPINS will finish the remaining spins with expanded THOR WILD.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_MAX_FS: FREE SPINS will finish the remaining spins.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_INFOLINE_4_FS_3: GROOM AND GUESTS pay increases in FREE SPINS!
texts.IDS_TOAFW_INFOLINE_3_FS_2: Expanded THOR MULTIPLIER increases on each step!
texts.IDS_TOAFW_INFOLINE_2_FS_1: Expanded THOR WILD up to x10 MULTIPLIER!
texts.IDS_TOAFW_INFOLINE_1_WILD2: Expanded FREYA WILD with x2 MULTIPLIER!
texts.IDS_TOAFW_FSINTRO_FSWILD: FREYA becomes THOR, MULTIPLIER can increase up to x10!
texts.IDS_TOAFW_FSINTRO_CONTINUE: FREE SPINS will continue as long as there is an expanded THOR WILD on the reels.
texts.IDS_TOAFW_FS_POPUP_HIGHER: Higher chance of getting an expanded THOR WILD!
texts.IDS_TOAFW_FS_POPUP_1: Expanded THOR WILD continues FREE SPINS!
texts.IDS_TOAFW_ADD_FSWILD: Only the expanded THOR WILD is available during FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TO_GROW_BONUS: on the screen to grow the bonus!
texts.IDS_TLS_X_MED_PACK_SCATTERS_FREESPINS: 3 or more SCATTER MED PACKS trigger FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TLS_PT2_EXTRA_SPLITTING_SYMBOL_DESC: The splitting symbol on triggering spin carries over into FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TLS_PT2_COLLECT_SYMBOLS_DESC: Collect the remaining symbol types in turn to upgrade them and win additional FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_TLS_PT1_RANDOM_SPLITTING_DESC3: Any symbol can split, except for SCATTER.
texts.IDS_TLS_PT1_RANDOM_SPLITTING_DESC2: Each instance of that symbol that lands will split.
texts.IDS_TLS_PT1_RANDOM_SPLITTING_DESC1: On each regular spin, a symbol is randomly selected to split.
texts.IDS_TLS_INFO_RANDOM_SPLITTING_SYMBOL: Each spin a symbol is randomly selected to split!
texts.IDS_TLS_INFO_FS_SPLITTING_UP_TO: Collect up to 11 splitting symbols in FREE SPINS!
texts.IDS_TLS_INFO_FS_COLLECT_SPLITTING_SYMBOL: Collect symbols in FREE SPINS to make them split!
texts.IDS_TLS_FS_INTRO_PANEL_COLLECT: Collect chosen symbols to upgrade them into splitting symbols!

texts.IDS_TLFW_OS_ORBS: FUEL CELL symbols may trigger FREE SPINS.

texts.IDS_TLFW_INFOLINE1: GOOD LUCK FOR THE MEGA LAUNCH PRIZE!

texts.IDS_TLFW_DES3_PAYTABLE2: FUEL CELLS can land anywhere during the Base Game, one per color.

texts.IDS_TLFW_DES2_PAYTABLE1: Each ROCKET comes with its own SPECIAL WILD in FREE SPINS.

texts.IDS_TLFW_DES1_PAYTABLE7: Land the LAUNCH BUTTON to activate the chance to win a LAUNCH PRIZE.
texts.IDS_TLFW_DES1_PAYTABLE3: If a ROCKET becomes FULLY FUELED, FREE SPINS trigger with the corresponding SPECIAL WILD. 10 FREE SPINS are awarded initially.
texts.IDS_TLFW_DES1_PAYTABLE2: Each FUEL CELL Symbol that lands during the base game will charge the corresponding ROCKET.
texts.IDS_TLFW_DES1_PAYTABLE1: Each ROCKET above the reels is charged when an FUEL CELL Symbol of the same colour lands.
texts.IDS_TLFW_DES1_FPS2: Land the LAUNCH BUTTON for a chance to trigger LAUNCH PRIZES!
texts.IDS_TLFW_DES_FPS1: Land FUEL CELLS to trigger up to 7 different FREE SPINS modes with SPECIAL WILDS!

texts.IDS_staticnightmare_12: During the FREE SPINS, all WILDS are sticky, and 1-3 WILDS are added to the reel on the first FREE SPIN. If a WILD expands during the FREE SPINS then it expands downwards instead of upwards. At the end of each FREE SPIN, before marked symbols fall, all WILDS will shrink back into 1 tall if they were expanded and then attempt to move horizontally. WILDS can't cross gaps and can't move to a position occupied by another WILD. If no valid horizontal move is available for a WILD, then it will attempt moving 1 step upwards instead. WILDS will try to avoid falling positions as much as possible when moving. Extra reel positions created by WILD expansion are marked for falling.
texts.IDS_staticnightmare_11: The WILD symbol substitutes for all symbols except scatter. Whenever a SCATTER lands, all wilds currently present on the reels will expand by 1. At the end of each spin, if no scatter is on the reel, each wild has an independent chance of expanding 1-3. The maximum WILD height is 4, and a WILD can't expand further if there is a SCATTER directly above it or if it has reached the maximum reel height of 6.
texts.IDS_staticnightmare_10: During FREE SPINS, reel expansion adds new symbol positions to the bottom of the reel instead. All symbol positions added by the reel expansion are marked for falling. Landing 3 scatters during a FREE SPIN adds 8 additional FREE SPINS to the current total. The maximum amount of FREE spins available is 40.
texts.IDS_staticnightmare_09: 3 SCATTER symbols trigger 8 FREE SPINS. Whenever a scatter symbol lands, the reel expands, adding up to 6 new symbol positions.
texts.IDS_staticnightmare_08: At the start of each FREE SPIN, a random number of symbols on the bottom of the reel will become marked for falling, and then at the end of each FREE SPIN, all marked symbols will fall from the reel, reducing the total reel size. Between each spin, a new full row is added on top of the reel, increasing the total reel size.

texts.IDS_RT_PT_GARGANTOON_P1: If the Quantum queue reaches the Gargantoon, the 3x3 sized monster appears as wild and substitutes for all symbols
texts.IDS_RT_PT_FURYDESC: On any initial non-winning spin, there is a chance for the Gargantoon to drop 4 to 8 wild symbols onto the grid

texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_23: Way wins are awarded for adjacent symbol combinations from left to right. Large symbols count as 1 symbol on each reel they occupy.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_22: During FREE SPINS, all large symbols enter with a multiplier. The multiplier starts at x3, but for every 4th TREASURE TURN trigger during FREE SPINS, the base multiplier is upgraded by +x1 for the remainder of the FREE SPINS. Each SCATTER gives a +2 FREE SPIN retrigger whenever they land.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_20: WILDS substitute for all symbols except SCATTERS. If a WILD is crushed, it will reform in a new position on the same reel.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_18: During the TREASURE TURN, there is a chance for the STARFALL feature to activate. Removing symbols and or creating wilds.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_16: Landing 3 scatters in the basegame triggers 8 FREE SPINS. Scatters are saved in the SCATTER meter between TREASURE TURNS but disappear at the end of each spin.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_15: During the TREASURE TURN, if there is a partial gap beneath a large symbol, the symbol below it will be crushed. For each crushed symbol, the crushing symbol gains a +x1 multiplier. If a large symbol crushes a symbol that already has a multiplier, it will absorb that multiplier. Multipliers stack additively.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_13: The game features large 2x2-sized symbols that occupy four positions on the reel. These large symbols are evaluated as one symbol per reel they occupy.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_11: After each win, a TREASURE TURN is triggered. Winning symbols are removed from the reels, then the reel rotates 90 degrees counterclockwise, then all remaining symbols slide downward as much as possible, and new symbols are added from the top creating new win opportunities.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_08: The universe keeps turning with TREASURE TURN!
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_06: Large symbols start with a x3 MULTIPLIER, turning the planet 360 degrees upgrades the starting multiplier by +x1.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_05: Crushed WILDS reform in the same reel.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_04: Large symbols can crush other symbols.
texts.IDS_ROSYORBIT_01: The reel rotates after each win.

texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT4: There are 15 stages of MULTIPLIERS which are X2, X3, X4, X5, X7, X8, X10, X12, X15, X20, X25, X50, X100, X500, and X1000 of total bet.

texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT27: When winning with multiple symbols, all wins are added to total win.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT26: Winning combinations and payouts are made according to the paytable. Only the highest win is paid per winning symbol combination.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT25: 8+ of the same symbols anywhere on the grid awards a scattered win.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT23: Any MULTIPLIERS that are used in a win are carried over until the last round of FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT22: MULTIPLIERS are cumulative in FREE SPINS.

texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT19: Final stage MULTIPLIERS (X1000) can no longer be upgraded.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT18: While the round cascades, SUPER UPGRADE can trigger multiple times to MULTIPLIERS that have been upgraded at least once.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT17: SUPER UPGRADE increases the MULTIPLIER value randomly from 1 stage higher up to the final stage (X1000).
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT15: When MULTIPLIERS that have already been upgraded once exist in the grid and the round cascades, there’s a chance to trigger SUPER UPGRADE.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT14: Final stage MULTIPLIERS (X1000) that have landed can no longer be upgraded.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT13: When a MULTIPLIER is upgraded for the first time, it increases by 1 stage higher.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT11: If GO ULTRA is turned on and MULTIPLIERS have landed, it is guaranteed to upgrade by 1 stage higher.
texts.IDS_ROO1K_PT10: When MULTIPLIERS land in the grid and the round cascades, there’s a chance to upgrade it by 1 stage higher.

texts.IDS_REX3_PT_FS_OPTION3_3: The bone meter initially requires 6 steps to be filled, but will increase by 1 step the first 2 times it is filled to a maximum of 8 steps. (1st = 6 steps, 2nd = 7 steps, 3rd or above = 8 steps)
texts.IDS_REX3_PT_FS_OPTION3_2: Each Bone symbol will fill the bone meter by 1 step. Filling the bone meter will remove all bone symbols and upgrade the values of the dinosaur symbols going forward by an amount equal to their start values, the Bone meter is then reset.
texts.IDS_REX3_PT_FS_OPTION3_1: Played using 3 lives, each spin uses 1 life. Whenever a dinosaur symbol lands in any of the 12 positions it gets eaten and refills all lives. Eaten dinosaurs are replaced with sticky Bone symbols and have their value absorbed by REX. Dinosaur symbol starting Value: x1, x2, x5, x10. REX's value will be paid out when the feature ends.
texts.IDS_REX3_PT_FS_OPTION1_2: Whenever REX moves across or stops on a hunting target, it will be consumed. For every 6th hunting target consumed, REX will receive +x1 infinitely stacking multiplier. (x2, x3, x4, x5...)

texts.IDS_RaR_DES8_PAYTABLE2: There are chances to reveal JAR or CLASH symbols in each BRONZE, SILVER, and GOLDEN DIVINE FRAME.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES7_PAYTABLE2: If a RA’S BLESSING symbol is present on the grid after all winning combinations have been awarded, the BRONZE, SILVER, and GOLDEN frames will reveal BRONZE, SILVER, and GOLDEN COINS respectively.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES4_PAYTABLE8: DIVINE FRAMES can be activated multiple times.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES4_PAYTABLE6: When no more JAR symbols appear, the values of all COIN and JAR symbols are added together and multiplied by your bet amount to calculate your final win.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES3_PAYTABLE8: All the DIVINE FRAMES remain STICKY throughout the entire FREE SPINS round.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES3_PAYTABLE6: All the DIVINE FRAMES will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process repeats until no more JAR symbols appear.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES3_PAYTABLE5: CLASH symbols can have the following values: x2, x3, x5 and x10.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES3_PAYTABLE3: If there are not any DIVINE FRAMES on the grid, the symbol will not activate.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES3_PAYTABLE2: Progress through the tiers by forming additional winning combinations over a special frame during the MEGA DROP.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES3_PAYTABLE1: The feature continues to activate as long as new winning combinations are formed consecutively.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE8: Landing 4, 5, or 6 SCATTERS award, 8, 10, or 12 INITIAL FREE SPINS respectively.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE6: Collect the values of all COINS and other JAR symbols on the grid and store the total MULTIPLIER sum.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE5: CLASH symbol multiplies all COINS and JAR symbols (full version) on adjacent squares.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE4: Each COIN on the grid awards a cash prize, and the total sum of these prizes is a multiple of your bet.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE3: Activates all the DIVINE FRAMES on the grid, transforming all symbols over the frames into BRONZE, SILVER, and GOLDEN COINS. Additionally, some symbols may be converted into JAR or CLASH symbols.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE2: The frames progress through three tiers: BRONZE, SILVER, and GOLDEN, each offering increasing rewards.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE1: New symbols will then cascade down to fill the empty spaces
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_PAYTABLE0: The WILD symbol can contribute to multiple winning combinations within the same spin.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES2_FSPS1: Landing 2 SCATTERS awards 2 more FREE SPINS. Each additional SCATTER awards 2 more FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE8: 4, 5 or 6 SCATTER symbols trigger a special FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE7: All the DIVINE FRAMES remain STICKY between spins until activated by a RA’S BLESSING symbol.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE5: This special symbol appears when DIVINE FRAMES are activated by a RA’S BLESSING symbol.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE4: COIN symbols are revealed when the DIVINE FRAMES are activated by RA’S BLESSING.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE3: The symbol lands randomly during any spin. Only 1 per spin.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE2: After a winning combination is formed, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted with special frames.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE1: When a winning combination is formed, all regular paying symbols of the same kind will be cleared from the grid, even those outside the win.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_PAYTABLE0: This symbol substitutes for any other symbol except SCATTER and special reward symbols triggering by RA’S BLESSING: COINS, JAR and CLASH symbols.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_FSPS2: DIVINE FRAMES remain STICKY until FREE SPINS end.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES1_FSPS1: DIVINE FRAMES remain STICKY until RA’S BLESSING activates.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES_FPS_2: Land 3 or more SCATTERS to trigger 2 FREE SPINS mode.
texts.IDS_RaR_DES_FPS_1: Land RA’S BLESSING to reveal cash prizes on previously winning positions.

texts.IDS_RAGGYSCURDEDCARNIVAL_PAYTABLE_UPGRAD: The Upgrade Trail will keep the progress if Hold'n Win is triggered in Raggy’s Funhouse. If Hold'n Win is triggered from the base game, the progress will reset

Jack in a Box symbol can land on reel 5 and lights one position on the Upgrade Trail. Once the Upgrade Trail is complete, no more Jack in a Box symbols can land. The upgrades will be applied to the next Hold'n Win feature.
texts.IDS_RAGGYSCURDEDCARNIVAL_PAYTABLE_SYMBOL: Coin symbols award the following in the Hold'n Win feature only (x total base bet): x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x8, x10, x12
Landing 6 or more in the base game triggers Raggy’s Funhouse feature
Jack in a Box symbol can land on reel 5 in the base game and increments Hold'n Win enhancement trail
Wild symbols can land on reels 1 to 5 in the base game and substitutes for all symbols except for Coin, and Jack in a Box symbols
INCREASE Coins can land on any spin in the Hold'n Win and increase 1 or more current values on every spin until the end of the Hold'n Win feature
MULTIPLY Coins can land on any spin in the Hold'n Win and multiplys 1 or more current values by a fixed multiplier of x2, x3, x4 before becoming a random value
MYSTERY Coins can land on any spin in the Hold'n Win and will award Mini, Minor, Major, Grand Instant Win
texts.IDS_RAGGYSCURDEDCARNIVAL_PAYTABLE_RAGGYS: When landing 5 Coin Symbols there is a random chance that Raggy will add additional Coins to trigger Hold'n Win
texts.IDS_RAGGYSCURDEDCARNIVAL_PAYTABLE_PAYWAY: Way wins are awarded for adjacent symbol combinations from left to right. Winning combinations begin with the left-most reel. Only highest winning combination paid per symbol combination.
texts.IDS_RAGGYSCURDEDCARNIVAL_PAYTABLE_INSTAN: Instant Wins can be won in Raggy’s Funhouse and Hold'n Win. Instant Win awards are:
texts.IDS_RAGGYSCURDEDCARNIVAL_PAYTABLE_HOLDNW: MULTIPLY Coins can land on any spin in the Hold'n Win and multiplys 1 or more current values by a fixed multiplier of x2, x3, x4 before becoming a random value
DOUBLE Coins can land on any spin in the Hold'n Win and multiplies 1 or more current values by x2 before becoming a random value
Coin symbols will land awarding the following random values (x total base bet): x0.4, x0.5, x0.6, x1, x1.2, x1.5, x2, x3, x5 and will be paid at the end of the feature.
Any upgrades that have been collected in the base game will be applied during the Hold'n Win
Hold'n Win can be triggered in the base game by landing 6 or more Coin symbols or by revealing in Raggy’s Funhouse
INCREASE Coins can land on any spin in the Hold'n Win and increase 1 or more current values on every spin until the end of the Hold'n Win feature
texts.IDS_RAGGYSCURDEDCARNIVAL_PAYTABLE_FUNHOU: Find the special Instant Win Wheel to reveal 1 of 4 Instant Wins.
Find Hold'n Win features that are played off once collected. Multiple Hold'n Win features are possible
Find cash values that reveal one of the following random cash values (x total bet) x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x8, x10, x12
Choose a door to find wins, Hold'n Win features or exit the Funhouse!
Coins can land on reels 1 to 5 and are collected into Raggy’s pay booth. During any collection Raggy’s Funhouse may randomly trigger.

texts.IDS_R4_PT_RNDWILDS_DESC: On any non-winning round, 5 to 10 QUANTUM WILDS may be added randomly.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_MEGA_WINS: When forming wins, a mega symbol counts as a single symbol, but its cluster value is used when determining the payout of the winning cluster. Each winning mega symbol leaves a WILD on the grid.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_MEGA_VALUE: Each mega symbol has a cluster value randomized up to 13.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_MEGA_SIZES: Mega symbols may appear in 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7 symbol sizes.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_MEGA_DROP: If a mega symbol cannot drop down, it fills up the space with its own 1x1 versions, without cluster values.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_GARGAWILDS_DESC: GARGANTOON WILDS may appear through the QUANTUMETER only.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_TRIGGER: When there are no more cascades, the next charge feature in line triggers.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVELS: Collect 25 charges for DISINTEGRATION, 50 for METAMORPHOSIS, 75 for RADIATION, and 100 for GARGANTOONZ!
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVEL5: GARGANTOONZ X2 is a stronger version of GARGANTOONZ with raised cluster values.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVEL4_3: Secondly, the mega GARGANTOONZ break down into 1x1 GARGANTOONZ, which are removed normally.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVEL4_2: Firstly, all mega symbols turn into mega GARGANTOONZ. At least 3 mega GARGANTOONZ appear, regardless of how many mega symbols are present. Additionally, 2-4 1x1 GARGANTOONZ appear. Mega GARGANTOONZ are not removed with wins.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVEL4: GARGANTOONZ plays out in 2 steps, one by one after wins conclude.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVEL3: RADIATION adds 0-4 mega symbols and 2-5 QUANTUM WILDS randomly.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVEL2: METAMORPHOSIS randomly transforms all instances of one symbol into a different symbol, including mega symbols.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_LEVEL1: DISINTEGRATION removes all instances of 4 randomly selected symbols.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_INACTIVATE: QUANTUMETER inactivates for the round if all features are played out.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_HOLDS: QUANTUMETER has 4 charge levels and holds up to 100 charges.
texts.IDS_R4_PT_CHARGER_CHARGE: Each winning symbol counts as one charge towards the QUANTUMETER, but mega symbols add their cluster values.
texts.IDS_R4_IL_MEGA_WIN: Mega symbols count as one when forming wins!
texts.IDS_R4_IL_MEGA_VALUE: Mega symbols add their cluster values to wins!
texts.IDS_R4_IL_MEGA_SIZE: Up to 7x7 sized mega symbols can land!
texts.IDS_R4_IL_CHARGER_LEVEL3: RADIATION adds mega and QUANTUM WILD symbols!
texts.IDS_R4_IL_CHARGER_LEVEL2: METAMORPHOSIS transforms all instances of a symbol!
texts.IDS_R4_IL_CHARGER_LEVEL1: DISINTEGRATION removes symbols from the grid!
texts.IDS_R4_FPS_MEGA: Form wins with mega symbols and reap the benefits of their cluster values!
texts.IDS_R2_PT_QUANTUMETER_RESET: QUANTUMETER resets on each new round.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_QUANTUMETER_RECHARGE: QUANTUMETER continues to charge after releasing an ENERGOON, but releasing GARGANTOON disables it.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_QUANTUMETER_MULTI: Collect 135 charges in total to reach level 4, the overcharged state.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_QUANTUMETER_LEVELS: Collect 55 charges for level 1, 85 for level 2, and 110 for level 3, the fully charged state!
texts.IDS_R2_PT_QUANTUMETER_HOLDS: QUANTUMETER has 4 charge levels and holds up to 135 charges.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_QUANTUMETER_CHARGE: Non-WILD symbols removed by an ELECTRIC WILD charge the QUANTUMETER.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_ORDER_DESC: The order priority after all the winning clusters are counted, and the cascades are done:
texts.IDS_R2_PT_GARGANTOON_MULTI: Level 4 adds a x2 multiplier for all wins including GARGANTOON WILDS, but only a single x2 multiplier is used for each winning cluster.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_GARGANTOON_ADD: If the QUANTUMETER is at level 3 or above, it unleashes GARGANTOON WILDS to the grid.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_GARGANTOON_3X3: Level 3 unleashes a single 3x3 GARGANTOON WILD.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_GARGANTOON_2X2: After 3x3 GARGANTOON triggers a cascade, it is replaced by two 2x2 GARGANTOON WILDS. After 2x2 GARGANTOON triggers a cascade, it is replaced by nine 1x1 GARGANTOON WILDS.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_FLUCTUATION: A one-eyed symbol is chosen at random to fluctuate on each round.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_FLUCTOMETER_COLLECT: FLUCTOMETER randomly creates 1, 2 or 3 ELECTRIC WILDS when fully filled.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_FLUCTOMETER_ACTIVE: FLUCTOMETER is constantly active and is rechargeable within a game round, but releasing GARGANTOON disables it.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_EWILDEXPL_TRIGGER: Activates when all features are done and there are 2 or more ELECTRIC WILDS remaining.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_EWILDEXPL_GRID: If there are 2 adjacent ELECTRIC WILDS, all other symbols except other WILDS are removed.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_EWILDEXPL_CHARGE: Symbols removed do not payout but do charge the QUANTUMETER.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_EWILDEXPL_BURST: If there are non-adjacent ELECTRIC WILDS only, symbols in-between 2 of them and their surrounding symbols are destroyed, excluding other WILDS.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_EWILD_FROZEN_FREE: UNCHARGED WILDS do not form wins but can transform into ELECTRIC WILDS when horizontally or vertically adjacent to winning symbols, or when WILD PAIR EXPLOSION triggers.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_EWILD_FROZEN_APPEAR: UNCHARGED WILDS can appear on the grid on any cascade.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_EWILD_CREATE: If fluctuating symbols win, an ELECTRIC WILD appears on any spot where a symbol was removed.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_ENERGOON_ADD: If the QUANTUMETER does not reach level 3, it unleashes ENERGOON WILDS to the grid.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_ENERGOON_2X2: Level 2 unleashes a single 2x2 ENERGOON WILD, at a cost of 30 charges.
texts.IDS_R2_PT_ENERGOON_1X1: Level 1 unleashes 4 symbols of 1x1 ENERGOON WILDS, at a cost of 55 charges.
texts.IDS_R2_GWILD_WILD: GARGANTOONZ and ENERGOONZ are absolutely WILD!
texts.IDS_R2_FPS_GARGANTOONWILDS: Charge the QUANTUMETER with ELECTRIC WILDS. Partial fills add ENERGOON WILDS; a full charge unleashes GARGANTOON WILDS!
texts.IDS_R2_FPS_ELECTRICWILDS: Create ELECTRIC WILDS by winning with fluctuating symbols, filling the FLUCTOMETER, and charging UNCHARGED WILDS!
texts.IDS_R2_FLUCT_COLLECT: FLUCTOMETER adds 1 to 3 ELECTRIC WILDS to the grid!
texts.IDS_R2_FLUCT_CHARGE: Fluctuating symbol wins charge the FLUCTOMETER!
texts.IDS_R2_FEWILD_DESC: WILD PAIR EXPLOSION or adjacent symbol wins turn UNCHARGED WILDS into ELECTRIC WILDS!
texts.IDS_R2_EWILD_FROZEN_FREE_WINS: UNCHARGED WILDS are charged by adjacent wins!
texts.IDS_R2_EWILD_FROZEN_FREE_EXPL: UNCHARGED WILDS are charged by EXPLOSION!
texts.IDS_R2_EWILD_CREATE: Fluctuating symbol wins create ELECTRIC WILDS!
texts.IDS_R2_CHARGER_FEATURE: QUANTUMETER unleashes WILDS onto the grid!
texts.IDS_R2_CHARGER_CHARGE: Winning ELECTRIC WILDS charge the QUANTUMETER!

texts.IDS_PUEBLA_PT_FS_MOVE: 8 FREE SPINS play out with all Pareja WILDS moving around.

texts.IDS_PH_VO92: It's time for a pirate's pick!
texts.IDS_PH_VO90: To me that sounds a little far-fetched.

texts.IDS_PH_VO60: Dead ahead! Ahahahah! I'm so funny.
texts.IDS_PH_VO6: harr, I mean ours, it will be ours of course!

texts.IDS_PH_VO51: I just sunk my teeth into you!

texts.IDS_PH_VO31: Yer tongue is like a cat o'nine tails.

texts.IDS_PH_VO27: It's not a crime … lawful seizure!
texts.IDS_PH_VO26: That's it, give up yer riches - to me!

texts.IDS_PH_VO20: Nah, I don't have pen on me.

texts.IDS_PH_VO17: I have a most illustrious pedigree!

texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FS_FPS_5: If ORPHEUS manages to reach Level 4 and escape the underworld then EURYDICE will be resurrected and become sticky.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FS_FPS_4: On levels 1, 2 and 3; if ORPHEUS is on the first reel at the end of a FREE SPIN, then he will advance to the next level granting +2 additional FREE SPINS, if not then he will move 1 step closer to the first reel.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FS_FPS_3: There are 4 FREE SPIN Levels. Levels 1, 2, and 3 are layers of the Underworld, while level 4 is the world of the living.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FS_FPS_2: EURYDICE’S multiplier grows each time she appears.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FS_FPS_1: ORPHEUS is sticky and always creates WILDS when he walks towards EURYDICE. Every wild created adds +1 to the WILD METER, filling the METER resets it and grants 1 additional FREE SPIN. The WILD METER requires 6, then 8, then 10, then 12 WILDS to fill. The maximum number of FREE SPINS achievable is 20.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FPS_4: Landing 3 CERBERUS heads triggers the underworld escape FREE SPIN.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FPS_3: Landing 2 CERBERUS heads trigger a RE-SPIN on each reel without a CERBERUS head.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FPS_2: EURYDICE gives a global multiplier whenever she is on the screen.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FPS_1: Whenever EURYDICE is on the screen ORPHEUS will walk towards her and may leave WILDS for each step moved.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_9: After pleading with the rulers of the underworld ORPHEUS was allowed to bring EURYDICE back to the surface on one condition. ORPHEUS was to walk in front of EURYDICE and not look back until they had both reached the surface. If he broke this promise, then theirs would be a fleeting reunion.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_8: None, living or dead may enter or leave the underworld as long as the entrance is guarded by the dreaded three-headed hound of HADES. While the great HERACLES once was able to subdue CERBERUS by force during his twelfth and final labour, ORPHEUS instead managed to pacify the beast with music.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_7: After PERSEPHONE’s abduction, DEMETER scoured the earth in search of her and the earth grew cold as the harvest goddess fell deeper into despair. Pressured by the other gods to resolve the crisis, ZEUS forced HADES to return PERSEPHONE to her mother. But before doing so HADES gave PERSEPHONE some pomegranate seeds to eat. After ingesting them, she was forever bound to the underworld and had to spend half of every year there with HADES but, every spring PERSEPHONE returned to the surface to console her mother's grief.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_6: A magical helmet that turns whoever wears it invisible. It was forged as a gift to HADES from the elder cyclopses that he and his two brothers ZEUS, and POSEIDON freed from TARTARUS during the war against the titans.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_5: After EURYDICE's tragic death, ORPHEUS was bereft of all worldly happiness and would do nothing but sing mournful requiems in her memory as both gods and nymphs started to weep. To console the crestfallen musician, they told him of a place where he could reclaim what the viper's venom had stolen.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_4: Queen of the underworld and goddess of Spring. PERSEPHONE once lived on Mount OLYMPUS before becoming the Queen of the underworld. HADES had fallen for her beauty but her mother DEMETER the goddess of the harvest would never have approved of the marriage, so her father ZEUS let her be abducted in secret.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_3: God of the dead and the oldest of the three brothers that defeated the titans and claimed the world for themselves. But while ZEUS' thunderclouds pass and POSEIDON'S stormy seas eventually grow calm, the dead never return. So when ORPHEUS, in his hubris, asked for the impossible, HADES made him a cruel bargain.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_2: An auloniad that fell in love with the offspring of the god and muse of music. His name was ORPHEUS, and he loved her true in turn, and soon they were husband and wife. Only the three fates know why tragedy struck just as their life together was about to truly start.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_10: At long last free of death's cold grasp, they now walked hand in hand with life's sweet days before them. An impossible happiness that was not meant to be.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_1: A gift from ORPHEUS' father APOLLO the god of music. Its divine tunes were meant to celebrate life and soothe the souls of the living, now the songs it plays are filled with melancholy and despair, the dead its only audience.
texts.IDS_ORPHEUS_FLAVOUR_0: Since birth, ORPHEUS was beloved by CALLIOPE the muse of poetry. Under her guidance, his heartfelt verses would come to move all who heard them. Not even the god of the dead could fully ignore ORPHEUS' plea the day he marched into the underworld.

texts.IDS_MOO_PT9: COLLECTOR SYMBOLS represent MOO-IGHTY ZEUS channeling different levels of divine power.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT7: If more than one COLLECTOR appears, the total value of all CASH SYMBOLS is collected by each COLLECTOR.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT6: Each framed position transforms into a CASH SYMBOL worth 0.5 - 10 the bet, and COLLECTOR SYMBOLS collects all visible CASH SYMBOLS.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT5: When a COLLECTOR SYMBOL lands, all active BOVINE FRAMES are activated.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT4: If no COLLECTOR SYMBOL appears during the spin, the frames disappear before the next spin begins.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT3: BOVINE FRAMES remain on the grid throughout the entire spin until all cascades have finished.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT29: The COLLECTOR applies stronger MULTIPLIERS to 5-7 CASH SYMBOLS before collecting them. Each MULTIPLIER adds the SYMBOL's base value once more, effectively increasing it.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT28: The COLLECTOR expands BOVINE FRAMES by a larger amount, adding 4-6 extra tile positions.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT27: The COLLECTOR summons new CASH SYMBOLS into BOVINE FRAMES and then collects them.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT26: The COLLECTOR applies MULTIPLIERS to 3-5 CASH SYMBOLS before collecting them. Each MULTIPLIER adds the SYMBOL's base value once more, effectively increasing it.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT25: The COLLECTOR expands the BOVINE FRAMES by 2-4 tile positions.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT24: The COLLECTOR SYMBOL gathers all CASH SYMBOL values in view.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT23: The MOO-IGHTY ZEUS feature is not active during FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT22: Only COLLECTOR Forms unlocked in the Base Game can appear during FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT21: Only one SCATTER of any type can land on each reel.

Landing 3 MOOLYMPUS SCATTERS triggers FREE SPINS.
If a SUPER SCATTER is included, OLYMPIAN SPINS are triggered.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT2: Winning clusters leave behind glowing BOVINE FRAMES on the grid.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT19: Bonus Prizes are: MINI: 20x, MAJOR: 50x, MEGA: 100x and GRAND: 1000x total bet.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT18: The MOO-IGHTY ZEUS may trigger randomly when one or more COLLECTORS are collected.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT17: In the Base Game, every COLLECTOR SYMBOL MOO-IGHTY ZEUS absorbs increases his divine power.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT15: Once all six stages are unlocked, the MAJOR, MEGA and GRAND prizes also become available, and further COLLECTORS no longer progress the path and only contribute to MOO-IGHTY ZEUS'S Power.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT14: The BOVINE PATH is divided into six stages, with only the MINI prize available at first. Completing each stage unlocks a new COLLECTOR type.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT13: Each COLLECTOR SYMBOL that lands charges the BOVINE PATH
texts.IDS_MOO_PT11: Each time it activates, all CASH SYMBOLS are collected, and the BOVINE PATH progresses.
texts.IDS_MOO_PT10: A COLLECTOR becomes active only when at least one BOVINE FRAME is present on the grid.

texts.IDS_KOS_PT_MULTI_WILD_DESC:
All multipliers will be applied to the cluster win the MULTIPLIER WILD takes part in. 
May bring 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x multipliers in Base Game. 
May bring 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x multipliers in Bonus Game.

texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_40: SCATTER symbol wins are exempt from reel positions and paylines, and only care about the number of SCATTER symbols on the reel.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_39: The game has 20 PAYLINES, and wins are awarded for adjacent symbol combinations from left to right. Winning combinations begin with the left-most reel. Only the highest winning combination paid per symbol combination. All wins are multiplied by bet staked per line.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_38: BONUS symbols may empower the INFERNO STAR. The INFERNO STAR, while extremely hot and radiating with power, has no impact on the features and is purely cosmetic.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_35: FREE SPINS uses a separate paytable from the basegame.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_34: SCATTER symbols and BONUS symbols may only land in the large reel during FREE SPINS. Landing a large BONUS symbol will pause the FREE SPIN and trigger a FREE SPIN version of the HOLD’N SPIN that also uses the large middle reel.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_33: During FREE SPINS, reels 2, 3, and 4 are combined into 1 large reel, which will always fully land a large 3x3 zised symbol.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_32: Land 3 SCATTER symbols to trigger 6 FREE SPINS, or Land 1 Large SCATTER to RETRIGGER +3 FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_31: Visually, the GAMBLE  is presented as 1 special spin, where either a yellow or blue BONUS symbol will land in each reel. The GAMBLE is won if the yellow bonus symbols are in the majority, and lost if the Blue ones are in the majority.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_30: IF the GAMBLE is initiated, then there is a 50% chance of doubling the total HOLD’N SPIN winnings, and 50% chance to lose it, setting the total winnings to 0. The GAMBLE can be repeated up to 4 times.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_29: After any HOLD’N SPIN triggered from the basegame is concluded, a GAMBLE option will be available if the total round winnings are equal to or less than 5000 times the bet.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_27: Filling all reel positions during the HOLD’N SPIN will also award the GRAND CASHPOT.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_26: The HOLD’N SPIN is played using 3 lives. Whenever a spin is started, a life is used, and whenever a new BONUS symbol is landed, the lives refill up to 3. When no lives remain, and no new spins can be started, the HOLD’N SPIN ends, and the combined value of all landed BONUS symbols’ prize values, and CASHPOTS is paid out.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_25: When the HOLD’N SPIN is triggered, the triggering BONUS symbols are carried over into the HOLD’N SPIN.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_24: The BONUS SYMBOL contain a random prize value, or a CASHPOT. Each BONUS symbol has a chance of triggering the HOLD’N SPIN. Landing 6 BONUS symbols guarantees it.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_22: Land 3 “LUCKY 7” symbols on reel 1 and a WILD on reel 2, 3, 4, and 5 to win the SPECIAL PATTERN, awarding 1000X the bet instead of the regular payline payouts. The SPECIAL PATTERN win is only available in the base game.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_20: Substitutes for all non-SCATTER symbols in payline combinations.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_19: The WILD symbol can land on reel 2,3,4 or 5 and expands if there is a win or a win can be formed using the expanded wild.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_17: The SCATTER symbol pays regardless of reel position or paylines as long as there is enough present on the reel.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_16: Land 3 SCATTER symbols to trigger 6 FREE SPINS, or Land 1 Large SCATTER to RETRIGGER +3 FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_INFERNOSTAREXTREME_13: The GAMBLE feature is unavailable in this mode.

texts.IDS_howtoplay_blitzways: Bets are selected using the bet buttons. Click the plus and minus buttons to change the bet one step at a time. BLITZWAYS wins are awarded when 3 or more symbols are connected horizontally or vertically on adjacent reels without any gaps, across a minimum of 3 reels. Winning combinations can start from any point on the grid. To start the round, click SPIN. When the reels stop, the symbols displayed determine your prize according to the paytable.

texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP9_L1: A middle-ground point number that also pays on the Field? Too good to be true but here we are with everyone's favorite Nina from Pasadena.
texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP8_L1:
All good things have come to an end eventually but why not finish the streak with a bang?

Use COME bet, place lose and any seven carefully to hedge your light side bets when the Big Red turns his head up!
texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP7_L1:
Betting on hardways can be risky but rewarding.

Roll a hard number before it comes easy to win, but beware, 7 also takes your bet.

texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP5_L1:
Place 6 and 8 are popular as they are the most common numbers after 7.

Avoid the Big 6 and 8 bet for better returns.
texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP4_L1: Place bets on 5 offer solid payouts but remember, there's no Field payout for 5. Since it hasn’t got much going on the light side why not use it to hedge other place bets?
texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP3_L1:
Opt for Buy bets instead of Place bets on the 4 for better payouts.

As a rare point number, it offers solid returns and can be used to hedge inside bets on cold tables.
texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP2_L1:
The most common craps number pays well on any Craps and C&E bets.

It also rewards Don’t Come and Don’t Pass bets on the dark side.
texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP10_L1:
Buy instead of place if you are betting on the outside.

If 10 is the point with don’t come or don’t pass bar bet in place consider doubling down with odds betting!
texts.IDS_GOCRAPS_FPS_TIP1_L1: A rare and unlucky number for Pass Line and Come bets, but the cold gaze of the snake eyes turns gold on the Field and Horn bets. Don’t miss the opportunity!

texts.IDS_DOI_33: The CREATURE feature is available during FREE SPINS. It can be randomly triggered after each FREE SPIN and guaranteed to trigger every fourth FREE SPIN that does not upgrade the MULTIPLIER. When activated, the CREATURE feature removes an average of 9 random normal symbols off the reels, triggering a CASCADE.
texts.IDS_DOI_29: The charges and MULTIPLIER are carried over into the FREE SPINS and do not reset during FREE SPINS.
texts.IDS_DOI_28: The game features a MULTIPLIER meter with 3 charge levels that can be filled. When the third charge is filled, a +1 MULTIPLIER is added to the meter, which accumulates to multiply the winnings of any subsequent wins for that round.
texts.IDS_DOI_27: The SPAWN symbol appears only on the top reel during the base game. When a SPAWN symbol CASCADES down to the main reels, the SPAWN feature will activate after there are no more CASCADES. The SPAWN feature removes the SPAWN symbol plus an average of 7 random normal symbols off the reels, triggering a new CASCADE.
texts.IDS_DOI_25: 3 SCATTER symbols in the main reels trigger/re-trigger 10 FREE SPINS
texts.IDS_DOI_24: The SCATTER symbol appears only on the top reel. Each SCATTER that CASCADES down to the main reels adds 3 charges to the MULTIPLIER meter. Additionally, each SCATTER already present on the main reels when a CASCADE is triggered adds 1 charge to the meter.
texts.IDS_DOI_23: The WILD symbol appears only on the top reel and substitutes for all symbols to form winning combinations. Each WILD that CASCADES down to the main reels adds 1 charge to the MULTIPLIER meter.
texts.IDS_DOI_21: DROPS OF INSANITY is a CASCADE video slot game featuring 5x3 main reels with 10 paylines and a special 5x3 top reel with no paylines. Winning symbols are removed, and new symbols drop in to fill up the reels. The game continues to CASCADE until no new winning combinations can be created. Symbols from the top reel will drop down to the main reels during CASCADES.

texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_18:
There are two Bet Panels making it possible to place two independent bets. 
One of these bets can be minimised to show more of the screen or expanded again if you wish to place more than one bet.
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_16: The bet size can be increased or decreased via the -/+ buttons either side of the bet button.
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_14:
If a Bet is placed and a game round has started and is still in progress pressing the CASH OUT button will win the amount shown on the button. 
Should the multiplier and total bet result in a win that would be less than a whole currency value then the total win will be rounded down. Example: Total Bet is 0.10 and Game Multiplier at CASH OUT is 1.56x = Total win of 0.15x the total bet.
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_12: Once a Bet is placed and before the next game begins the Cancel button will cancel the current bet.
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_10:
Places the current bet amount shown on the button. 
It is possible to place a bet while a current game is in progress, however that bet will not be made until the next game begins. It is not possible to place any bets for games already in progress.
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_08:
It is possible to set a multiplier threshold at which the game will automatically CASH OUT for you if the game multiplier reaches that threshold. 
You are however still able to manually CASH OUT before this. If the AUTO CASH OUT value is set higher than the multiplier that any given round reaches you will lose your bet providing you haven't already cashed out early. 
It is possible to enable both AUTO CASH OUT and AUTO PLAY at the same time. To Set the AUTO CASH OUT value use the - or + buttons either side of the AUTO CASH OUT multiplier value to increase or decrease the value from 1x - 5000x in pre-set steps. 
Holding down either: the - or + buttons will change the value of the AUTO CASH OUT multiplier value in greater steps. Releasing the button will reset the rate at which the value is changed. Tapping the AUTO CASH OUT button will enable AUTO CASH OUT at the AUTO CASH OUT multiplier value. AUTO CASH OUT can be disabled by tapping the button while it is enabled. AUTO CASH OUT does not guarantee a win!
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_06:
You can USE AUTO PLAY to set the BET and number of rounds that are played automatically. 
You must also set some thresholds to cancel AUTO PLAY should they be reached. 
AUTO PLAY can be cancelled at any time by pressing either the AUTO PLAY button after AUTO PLAY is enabled or by pressing the applicable bet Cancel Button. 
If a game is in progress and a wager is in progress cancelling AUTO PLAY will cancel any subsequent bets after the current round concludes and any bets already in play are not returned or cancelled. 
AUTO PLAY is independent of AUTO CASH OUT (see AUTO CASH OUT) and does not guarantee any CASH OUT values unless the player Cashes Out or has AUTO CASH OUT enabled. AUTO PLAY is cancelled when Crashback is triggered.
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_04: It is possible to place up to 4 simultaneous bets. You can use the toggle switch in the BET SETTINGS menu to switch the BET PANEL from 2 to 4 bets. Each bet can be separately configured with AUTOPLAY settings.
texts.IDS_CRASH_ACTIONS_02: Pressing BET SETTINGS button will open the BET SETTINGS menu.  Here you can toggle the BET PANEL to accommodate more simultaneous bets and configure the AUTO PLAY options.

texts.IDS_COA_PT_WILDS_SUBS: WILDS substitute for all other symbols, except SCATTERS and keys. They can contain master keys.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_WILDS_EXPAND: WILDS expand onto their reels to help form more wins.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_KEYS_WILD: WILD master keys substitute for all keys.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_KEYS_GODS: Gods and the WILD have their own unique keys.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_FREESPINS_TRIGGER: 3, 4, and 5 Mask SCATTERS award 8, 10 and 12 FREE SPINS respectively.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_FREESPINS_BRING: During FREE SPINS, all God symbols wear their masks and bring significantly more keys, while all WILD symbols bring theirs.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_FREESPINS_BONUS: FREE SPINS and BONUS games can be triggered in the same spin. BONUS games play out first and then FREE SPINS are triggered.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_VRAISER_DESC: Value Booster coin reveals a random value (3x value coin intervals), adds it to a coin and vanishes.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_SMULTI_DESC: Single Multiplier coin applies a 2x, 3x, 4x or 8x to a single coin and vanishes.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_SEQUENCE: The special coins activate their effects in a sequence: Mystery coin, Value Booster coin, Single Multiplier coin, Multiplier coin, Collector coin.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_NORMAL_DESC: Value coins award 0.1x to 5x the bet depending on the active BONUS chamber. ESET: 0.1x-0.5x. CAISHEN: 0.2x-1x. GANESHA: 0.3x-1.5x. ATHENA: 0.5x-2.5x. THOR: 1x-5x.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_MYSTERY_DESC: Mystery coin reveals a special or a God coin.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_HP5_DESC: THOR God coin awards 25x the bet.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_HP4_DESC: ATHENA God coin awards 12.5x the bet.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_HP3_DESC: GANESHA God coin awards 7.5x the bet.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_HP2_DESC: CAISHEN God coin awards 5x the bet.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_HP1_DESC: ESET God coin awards 2.5x the bet.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_GMULTI_DESC: Multiplier coin doubles all coin values on the screen and vanishes.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_COINS_COLLECTOR_DESC: Collector coin removes value coins and collects their values.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_BONUS_SPINS: 3 FREE SPINS are granted but reset if a coin lands in any position.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_BONUS_RESET: If all position are filled, coins are counted, removed, and the FREE SPIN counter resets.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_BONUS_OPEN: If 3+ identical keys land, a BONUS chamber opens. When 3+ master keys land, all chambers will open, one after the other.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_BONUS_LAYOUT: BONUS games are played on a 3x3 layout where coins can land in each position.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_BONUS_HELD: Coins may be held and/or activate their special functions.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_BONUS_COINTYPES: Each chamber features different value coins and all special coins.
texts.IDS_COA_PT_BONUS_ALL: All BONUS chambers can be opened in a spin!
texts.IDS_COA_OSPT_UI: High value God coins can be found in the chambers!
texts.IDS_COA_OSPT_KEY: 3 or more identical keys open a BONUS chamber!
texts.IDS_COA_IL_KEYS_WSUBSTITUTE: Master keys substitute for all keys!
texts.IDS_COA_IL_KEYS_BRING: Gods can bring keys in each spin!
texts.IDS_COA_IL_FS_KEYS: FREE SPINS offer a lot more keys!
texts.IDS_COA_IL_BONUS_RESET: The chambers reset when fully filled!
texts.IDS_COA_IL_BONUS_POTENTIAL: The chambers are increasingly higher in value!
texts.IDS_COA_IL_BONUS_OFFER: Each chamber activates a BONUS game!
texts.IDS_COA_IL_BONUS_GODCOINS: God coins offer high rewards in BONUS games!
texts.IDS_COA_FSINTRO_KEYS: All WILDS bring keys. Gods bring keys with higher chances.
texts.IDS_COA_FSBG_ACTIVATION: FREE SPINS will start after BONUS games!
texts.IDS_COA_FS_BGMULTI: BONUS games play out one by one!
texts.IDS_COA_FPS_KEYS_DESC: Gods bring keys to open BONUS chambers!
texts.IDS_COA_FPS_FS_DESC: Masks trigger FREE SPINS with a high number of keys!

Unlock the 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th rows by collecting 3, 10, 15, and  
20 Bonus Inferno Coins, respectively.

texts.IDS_BX_PT9: If MULTIPLIERS have been collected by the M-COUNTER this round, the win from FORTUNE FRENZY is multiplied by the M-COUNTER value.

texts.IDS_BWCP_INFO8_BONUS: Win a BONUS prize of up to 5000x!

texts.IDS_BSGG_XBETCOIN_DESC: Awards values computed from the total bet and a MULTIPLIER ranging from 0.4x to 8x at the end of the HOLD N' SPIN feature when landed on the reels.
texts.IDS_BSGG_SUMOSTASHCOIN_DESC: Triggers the SUMO STASH feature at the end of the HOLD N' SPIN feature when landed on the reels.
texts.IDS_BSGG_SUMOSCALE_SC2_DESC: This is an independent visual element with no functional relationship to the random outcome generation or associated probabilities of the game.
texts.IDS_BSGG_SUMOSCALE_SC1_DESC: Collects coins each time they appear on the reels.
texts.IDS_BSGG_SUMOCOINS_DESC_3: They are flipped over and revealed at the end of HOLD N' SPIN if landed on the reels during the feature.

texts.IDS_BSGG_SS_DESC_4: Each resulting value may vary and is randomly determined within the specified range.
texts.IDS_BSGG_SS_DESC_3: Each slap adds a value computed from the total bet and a MULTIPLIER ranging from 0.4x to 20x to the SUMO STASH coin.
texts.IDS_BSGG_SS_DESC_2: During the feature, TOMO will slap his belly 4 to 8 times, chosen at random.
texts.IDS_BSGG_SS_DESC_1: Triggers when a SUMO STASH coin is flipped over during HOLD N' SPIN.
texts.IDS_BSGG_REVEALSKIP: Press SPIN to reveal all coins

texts.IDS_BSGG_NOVA_HNS_TRIGGER: HOLD N' SPIN has been triggered with %d collected coin symbol(s).

texts.IDS_BSGG_MG_DESC_6: The feature ends when there are no more FREE SPINS left.

texts.IDS_BSGG_MG_DESC_1: This is a feature that triggers when three or more SCATTERS are landed on the reels during the base game.
texts.IDS_BSGG_INTRO_MG_2: LAND SPECIAL STACKED MYSTERY GATES FOR BIG WINS!
texts.IDS_BSGG_INTRO_HNS_3: SUMO STASH COINS TRIGGER THE SUMO STASH FEATURE!
texts.IDS_BSGG_INTRO_HNS_2: LAND AS MANY COINS AS YOU CAN FOR BIGGER REWARDS!

texts.IDS_BLITZWAYS_DESCRIPTION: BLITZWAYS wins are awarded for adjacent symbol combinations across a minimum of 3 reels where all symbols in the combination are connected horizontally or vertically in a cluster. Winning combinations can begin from any reel.
texts.IDS_BLITZWAYS_COMMON_DESCRIPTION: BLITZWAYS wins are awarded for adjacent symbol combinations, according to the information in the paytable and game rules. When winning on multiple BLITZWAYS in a single game round, all winnings are added together. All winnings from Features (such as Free Spins), Bonus Games and/or Scatters (if applicable) are also added to BLITZWAYS wins. All winning combinations are paid out at the end of a game round. Free Spin features are played with the same bet as the game round that triggered the feature – unless otherwise stated. The bet cannot be changed during a currently running game round. Please refer to the game rules for more information. Winning combinations only pay when symbols are connected horizontally or vertically on adjacent reels and without any gaps, across a minimum of 3 reels. Winning combinations can start from any point on the grid. Only the highest win is paid per winning symbol combination.
